operation.summary: The runtime log of this agent's device operations (outlet flow): every enroll, action and removal, in order, with trigger, device and outcome

query.name: op_id
query.description: Only the entries of one operation

query.name: since
query.description: Only entries after this log id

query.name: cursor
query.description: next_cursor from the previous page; keep the same filters

operation.returns: entries[id,ts,op_id,op(enroll|action|remove),phase(started|bind|retry|ok|failed|unknown_outcome),outcome,action,channel,device{id,name,adapter,host},trigger{agent_id,agent,via,request_id,method,endpoint},params,result,error,error_message,duration_ms,level,message], count, next_cursor, order, retention. Each operation writes started before anything reaches the device and one final entry; unknown_outcome means the device may have changed. Only your own entries; no credentials; URLs keep no query. Owner log retention applies; the same entries are in GET /v1/log?kind=lan

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; keep the same filters

op_id.description: Only the entries of one operation

since.description: Only entries after this log id
